Civfix - iOS, Android, and Web App

Report neighborhood problems in seconds. Civfix automatically routes each report to the right city agency, lets you track follow-ups, and helps neighbors organize community cleanups.

  • Web app: civfix.org
  • iOS: Download Civfix on the App Store
  • Android: android.civfix.org
